title: 19 River Walk, Dublin 17, Balgriffin, Dublin 17, D17EW73
seoTitle: 19 River Walk, Dublin 17, Balgriffin, Dublin 17, D17EW73
description:
Welcome to 19 River Walk, an impressive and beautifully presented three-bedroom, three-bathroom terraced home, ideally positioned within a peaceful and secluded modern development in Belcamp, Dublin 17.

Built in 2022, this superb property offers all the advantages of modern construction, combining contemporary design, excellent energy efficiency and stylish, low-maintenance living. Presented in genuine turn-key condition, this is a home where the new owners can simply move in, unpack and enjoy everything it has to offer.

From the moment you arrive, the quality and presentation of this attractive home are immediately apparent. The property has been exceptionally well maintained and provides bright, modern and generously proportioned accommodation throughout, making it an ideal choice for first-time buyers, young families, downsizers or those looking for a modern home without the expense and inconvenience of refurbishment.

A major feature of the property is its excellent A2 BER rating, reflecting the energy-efficient construction and modern systems incorporated into the home. The property benefits from a gas fired heating system, offering an efficient and economical heating solution while maintaining a comfortable temperature throughout the home. This combination of modern construction, energy efficiency and contemporary heating technology provides both comfort and peace of mind for the future.

Modern Family Accommodation

The accommodation has been thoughtfully designed around the requirements of modern family living. The ground floor offers bright and welcoming living accommodation, providing an excellent environment for both relaxing and entertaining. The modern finish throughout creates a fresh and contemporary feel, while the turn-key condition means there is little for the new owner to do other than enjoy the property.

Upstairs are three well-proportioned bedrooms, providing excellent flexibility for family accommodation, guests or working from home. The property also benefits from three bathrooms, a particularly valuable feature for a three-bedroom home and one which adds considerably to the practicality of everyday living.

The house combines modern styling with functionality, creating a comfortable home that should appeal strongly to purchasers seeking a property that is ready to move straight into.

Peaceful & Secluded Setting

One of the property's most appealing features is its position within this quiet and secluded development. River Walk provides residents with a peaceful residential setting away from busy main roads, while still being exceptionally well positioned for access to the surrounding amenities.

The location is particularly attractive for families, with a strong selection of schools and childcare facilities within the surrounding area. St. Francis of Assisi Primary School and Belmayne Educate Together National School are both within approximately 1km, while St. Paul's, Donahies Community School, Belmayne Educate Together Secondary School and Grange Community College are also conveniently accessible.

Excellent Local Amenities

Residents of River Walk are exceptionally well served by local amenities. The wider Belcamp and Belmayne area provides a convenient selection of shops, cafés, pharmacies, childcare facilities, sports clubs and community amenities, with Clarehall Shopping Centre nearby providing a broad range of retail and everyday services. Local amenities in the area also include Eurospar, pharmacy services, childcare facilities and other neighbourhood conveniences.

For families and those who enjoy an active lifestyle, the area has an excellent selection of recreational facilities. Father Collins Park is a major local amenity, offering extensive green space, playing pitches, a lake, walking areas and a skate park. Belcamp Park also provides sports facilities including GAA and soccer pitches, tennis courts, pitch and putt and an all-weather football pitch.

The area also benefits from nearby GAA and sporting clubs, childcare facilities and community services, making it a particularly practical location for modern family life.

Excellent Transport Connections

The location is particularly convenient for commuters, with regular bus services available along the Malahide Road, including stops within a short walk of River Walk. The property is also ideally positioned for access to the M1 and M50, Dublin Airport and the wider North Dublin road network. The nearby DART network provides further connectivity towards Dublin City Centre and the north Dublin coastline, with Portmarnock DART station accessible from the area.

The property's location also provides easy access towards Malahide, Portmarnock, Baldoyle and the north Dublin coastline, while Dublin City Centre and DCU are readily accessible via the Malahide Road.

A Modern Home in a Superb Location

19 River Walk successfully combines the qualities buyers increasingly look for in today's market: modern construction, excellent energy efficiency, contemporary heating technology, generous accommodation and a peaceful residential setting.

The A2 BER rating and air-to-water heating system offer excellent energy credentials, while the three-bedroom, three-bathroom layout provides the flexibility required by modern families.

Add to this the excellent selection of nearby schools, childcare, shopping, parks, sporting facilities and transport links, and it becomes clear why River Walk is such an attractive place to call home.

19 River Walk represents a fantastic opportunity to acquire a modern, energy-efficient and beautifully maintained family home in a peaceful yet exceptionally convenient Dublin 17 location. Properties offering this combination of age, condition, energy efficiency and location are sure to generate significant interest, and early viewing is highly recommended.
